h: Tinubu asks Senate to approve external borrowing plan worth over $20.5 billion and €1.045 billion
p: President Tinubu has reportedly written to the Senate seeking approval for a 2026–2027 external borrowing plan of more than $20.5 billion and €1.045 billion. The request is said to be awaiting consideration by lawmakers.
more: The plan covers the 2026–2027 borrowing period, according to reports.
Lawmakers are expected to debate the request when the Senate next sits.
